description: This file implements the NatsQueueAdapterReceiver class which acts as a receiver for a NATS-based streaming provider within Orleans. It manages NATS connections, message retrieval, deserialization, and message acknowledgment for a specific partition.

classes.name: NatsQueueAdapterReceiver
classes.description: A class that implements IQueueAdapterReceiver to receive and process messages from a NATS streaming server, handling initialization, message retrieval, and acknowledgment.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new NatsQueueAdapterReceiver with specified parameters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the consumer by connecting to the NATS stream for the specified partition within a given timeout.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the receiver, waits for ongoing message processing, and releases resources.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves messages from NATS, deserializes them into batch containers, and returns the list.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Acknowledges the delivery of messages back to NATS, if applicable.
